description: Explicit event-packet policy for the simultaneous-event question. INPUT carries alpha/beta/gamma booleans. alpha and beta choose B; alpha without beta chooses C. gamma alone stays in A. D is intentionally unreachable because this policy rejects self-justifying left A. This policy illustrates the question rather than resolving Harel semantics.
